messages:
Carla R.: Heads up team, PM-2026-117 follow-up	6 items	7 - a couple are overdue and we need status for the weekly L3 digest. Please post quick status updates.

Carla R.: From the action list:
```
A1 - tune request-queue mem limits (owner: Ben T.) - due 2026-03-19
A2 - add model-variant fallback policy (owner: Dinesh P.) - due 2026-03-17
A3 - instrument prefix-cache eviction alert (owner: Alice M.) - due 2026-03-15
A4 - update runbook with new routing rules (owner: Sandra L.) - due 2026-03-20
```

Ben T.: A1: I opened a lightweight PR (runtime repo) with config changes. Needs perf job approval. Link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/pull/1009. ETA after perf: 24h.

Dinesh P.: A2: Sorry, slipped past me. I hit a blocker with the canary harness; working with infra. Will post new ETA by EOD.

Alice M.: A3: Added alert rule to staging and ran 48h smoke. Eviction spikes look within expected; alert thresholds tweaked. Marking as verifying. :white_check_mark:

SRE Bot: :warning: Action A2 is 1 day past due. Owner: Dinesh P.

Carla R.: Dinesh, please update ETA here. If you can't finish by EOD I'll escalate to eng leads and we might reassign.

Dinesh P.: Confirmed blocker is an unrelated infra flake causing canary failures. Infra team investigating. New ETA 2026-03-23 18:00 UTC. If infra doesn't clear, propose temporary fallback implementation to meet SLA.

Ben T.: Re: PR 1009 I added a testing note and linked to PM-2026-117 doc. Also added a short rollback plan. Sandra, can you run a quick smoke after Ben merges?

Sandra L.: Yep, I'll run smoke tomorrow morning and post results here. Local run looked okay.

Carla R.: Summary for rollup: A3 done-in-verification (Alice), A1 PR open awaiting perf (Ben), A2 overdue/reassigned-if-needed (Dinesh) - ETA 2026-03-23, A4 not started (Sandra) - please confirm start date.

Sandra L.: A4: I'll start drafting the runbook updates after smoke verification tomorrow. Expect first pass by 2026-03-24.

Carla R.: Thanks. If A2 doesn't have infra unblock by 18:00 UTC I'll ping Eng leads for help. Please @mention me if you need escalation sooner. :thumbsup:
